title: Lab 4C — Step Functions capstone
topic: Step Functions Standard vs Express, ECS runTask.sync, SQS/Lambda/SNS service integrations, Retry/Catch, iam:PassRole, GSA Iceland pipeline orchestration, migration from EventBridge chain
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-32-stepfunctions-capstone.md and gsa-stepfunctions-map.md. Answer without peeking at night-32-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas needs a monthly workflow: run Iceland Fargate for up to two hours, enqueue completion to SQS, invoke a stats Lambda, and route failures to SNS with different retry counts per step. Which service is the best orchestration fit?

options.A: EventBridge schedule with five separate rules only
options.B: SQS FIFO queue with a single consumer

questions.question: The capstone uses `arn:aws:states:::ecs:runTask.sync` for Iceland. What does the `.sync` suffix mean for the state machine?

options.A: Step Functions waits until the ECS task reaches STOPPED before advancing
options.B: ECS pushes a callback token when the container starts
options.C: The task runs synchronously inside the Lambda runtime
options.D: EventBridge forwards ECS events without waiting

questions.question: A Step Functions `RunTask` state fails with `ECS.AmazonECSException` after two retries. The ASL has a `Catch` to `PublishFailureAlert` (SNS). What happens next?

options.A: The execution ends successfully because Retry ran
options.B: The Catch state runs and publishes to the Night 14 alerts topic
options.C: SQS automatically moves the message to the DLQ
options.D: EventBridge disables the monthly schedule rule

questions.question: Night 32 deploys a new EventBridge rule `saa-study-gsa-iceland-monthly-sfn` targeting the state machine. The legacy `saa-study-gsa-iceland-monthly` rule still targets ECS directly. What is the operational risk?

options.B: Two Iceland Fargate tasks may start on the same schedule
options.C: Step Functions Express history is truncated

questions.question: Which IAM permission must the Step Functions execution role have for `ecs:RunTask` on the Iceland task definition?

options.A: s3:PutObject on the output bucket only
options.C: iam:PassRole to the ECS execution role and task role
options.D: events:PutTargets on the legacy monthly rule

questions.question: An exam scenario needs sub-minute fan-out of thousands of short payment authorizations with optional discarded execution history. Which Step Functions type fits?

options.A: Standard — full audit trail for every authorization
options.B: Express — high volume, short duration, lower per-execution overhead

questions.question: After `RunIcelandTask` succeeds, the capstone sends a message to `saa-study-gsa-iceland-completion` via `sqs:sendMessage`. Why keep SQS instead of only synchronous Lambda invoke?

options.A: SQS is required because Lambda cannot be invoked from Step Functions
options.B: Durable buffer + existing Night 17 event source mapping / decoupled replay path
options.C: SQS schedules cron expressions for monthly runs
options.D: SNS fan-out is slower than SQS for all workloads

questions.question: In the Night 32 ASL, `InvokeStatsUploader` has Retry on `Lambda.ServiceException` but Catch on `States.ALL` to SNS. Lambda returns a handled error in the payload with HTTP 200. What happens?

options.A: Catch runs immediately because the function returned JSON
options.B: Retry runs because ServiceException was not thrown
options.C: The Task state succeeds and the workflow continues to PublishSuccess
options.D: The execution pauses until the DLQ redrives

questions.question: How does AWS primarily bill Step Functions Standard workflows?

options.A: Per state transition (and duration for some integrations)
options.B: Per ECS cluster hour regardless of executions
options.D: Flat monthly fee per state machine definition

questions.question: Night 28 used EventBridge `saa-study-gsa-iceland-success-to-sqs` on ECS Task State Change. Night 32 Step Functions also `sendMessage`s to the same queue. What should you do to avoid duplicate completion messages?

options.A: Delete the SQS queue and recreate it
options.B: Disable the legacy success EventBridge rule or remove its target when SFN owns enqueue
options.C: Switch the queue to FIFO with content-based deduplication only
options.D: Replace SNS with Kinesis Data Streams

questions.question: A human approval gate is required mid-workflow before publishing ski stats to production Aurora. Which Step Functions pattern applies?

options.B: Task state with `.waitForTaskToken` until an operator calls `SendTaskSuccess`
options.C: SQS long polling from the state machine definition

questions.question: The Iceland container exits with code 1 after starting. With `runTask.sync`, how should the capstone surface failure to operators?

options.A: CloudWatch FailedInvocations on the schedule rule — container ran
options.B: The RunTask state fails; Catch routes to SNS failure publish
options.C: SQS redrive policy sends email automatically
options.D: Step Functions Express discards the error

questions.question: Which integration ARN publishes a success notification to the existing `saa-study-gsa-iceland-alerts` topic at the end of a happy path?
Why is Step Functions Standard (not Express) correct for the Iceland capstone?

options.B: Express max duration is five minutes — Iceland may run two hours
options.D: Express requires FIFO SQS as the first state

questions.question: A teammate suggests replacing the entire Night 32 state machine with a single EventBridge cron → `ecs:RunTask` like Night 12. What capability would they lose?

options.A: Ability to run Fargate in private subnets
options.B: Per-step Retry/Catch, synchronous wait for STOPPED, and visible multi-step execution graph
options.D: Using IAM roles on ECS tasks
